###############################################################
# 1. Introduction
###############################################################

The purpose of this document is to build the reference spectral library of the
HUMAN Metabolomics Ring Trial using exclusively the Bioconductor
RforMassSpectrometry ecosystem.

The final library will be stored as a `CompDb` SQLite database containing

- compound annotations,
- MS/MS spectra,
- acquisition metadata,
- laboratory-specific metadata.

The resulting database constitutes the master representation of the Ring Trial
spectral library and can later be exported to external formats such as MSP or
MassBank.

The workflow implemented in this document follows the strategy proposed in the
official `CompoundDb` vignette while adapting it to the specific needs of the
Ring Trial.

###############################################################
# 6. Enrich provenance table with information from the standards table and the Ring_trial_setups_summary table
###############################################################

```{r}

###############################################################
# Enrich provenance table with information from the standards table
###############################################################

standards_file <-
    "C:/Users/amart/Desktop/HUMAN Ring Trial/HUMAN_Ring_Trial-main (copia para GitHub)/HUMAN_Ring_Trial/1_preprocessing/standards.xlsx"

# Read standards table
# Column names are located in the second row of the Excel file

standards <-
    read_excel(
        standards_file,
        skip = 1
    )

# Columns to import from standards

standards_annotation_columns <- c(
    "InChIKey",
    "ChEBI",
    "KEGG",
    "HMDB",
    "LipidMaps",
    "SMILES",
    "InChI",
    "M"
)

# Check that all required columns are present

missing_standards_columns <-
    setdiff(
        standards_annotation_columns,
        colnames(standards)
    )

if (length(missing_standards_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
        paste(
            "The following columns are missing from standards.xlsx:",
            paste(
                missing_standards_columns,
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    )
}

# Check uniqueness of InChIKey in standards

duplicate_standards_inchikey <-
    standards |>
    dplyr::group_by(InChIKey) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

duplicate_standards_inchikey

# Keep only the required annotation columns, removing duplicated InChIKey

standards_annotations <-
    standards |>
    dplyr::select(
        dplyr::all_of(
            standards_annotation_columns
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
        !HMDB %in% c(
            "HMDB0060079",
            "HMDB0000805",
            "HMDB0029881"
        )
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(InChIKey) |>
    dplyr::filter(
        if (any(!is.na(HMDB))) {
            !is.na(HMDB)
        } else {
            TRUE
        }
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

# Re-check uniqueness of InChIKey in standards after cleaning

duplicate_standards_inchikey <-
    standards_annotations |>
    dplyr::group_by(InChIKey) |>
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() > 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

duplicate_standards_inchikey

if (nrow(duplicate_standards_inchikey) > 0) {
    stop(
        paste(
            "The standards table contains duplicated InChIKeys with different annotations.",
            "The join may generate multiple rows per provenance entry.",
            "Resolve these duplicates before joining with provenance.",
            paste(
                duplicate_standards_inchikey$InChIKey,
                collapse = ", "
            )
        )
    )
}

# Add standards annotations to provenance

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::left_join(
        standards_annotations,
        by = c(
            "target_InChIKey" = "InChIKey"
        )
    )

# Check the enrichment

provenance |>
    dplyr::select(
        target_InChIKey,
        ChEBI,
        KEGG,
        HMDB,
        LipidMaps,
        SMILES,
        InChI,
        M
    ) |>
    head()

n_total <-
    sum(
        !is.na(provenance$target_InChIKey)
    )

n_matched <-
    sum(
        provenance$target_InChIKey %in%
        standards$InChIKey
    )

n_matched
n_total

unmatched_inchikeys <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(target_InChIKey),
        !target_InChIKey %in% standards$InChIKey
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(
        target_InChIKey
    )

unmatched_inchikeys

```

###############################################################
# 7. Adapt provenance table column names/content/format to CompoundDb and MsBackendCompDb conventions
###############################################################

```{r}

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        predicted = FALSE
    )

# Add instrument type

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        instrument_type = "LC-MS"
    )

# Add synonyms

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        synonyms = sirius_structure
    )

# Rename columns to Spectra conventions

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::rename(
        rtime = rt_sec,
        acquisitionNum = acquisition_num,
        scanIndex = scan_index,
        inchi = InChI,
        instrument = LC_instrument,
        name = compound,
        formula = molecular_formula,
        inchikey = target_InChIKey,
        exactmass = M
    )

# Convert exact mass to CompDb-compatible numeric values

provenance <-
    provenance |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        exactmass = as.numeric(exactmass)
    )

```

###############################################################
# 8. Locate mzML files
###############################################################

```{r}

find_mzml_file <-
function(lab,
         mzml_name,
         polarity,
         mzml_dirs){
    if(lab == "afekta"){
        directory <- mzml_dirs$AFEKTA
    }
    else if(lab == "hmgu"){
        directory <- mzml_dirs$HMGU
    }
    else if(lab == "cembio"){
        if(polarity == "pos"){
            directory <- mzml_dirs$CEMBIO_POS
        } else if(polarity == "neg"){
            directory <- mzml_dirs$CEMBIO_NEG
        } else {
            stop(
                paste(
                    "Invalid polarity for CEMBIO:",
                    polarity
                )
            )
        }
    }
    else{
        stop(
            paste(
                "Unknown laboratory:",
                lab
            )
        )
    }
    candidate <-
        file.path(
            directory,
            mzml_name
        )
    if(!file.exists(candidate)){
        stop(
            paste(
                "File not found:",
                candidate
            )
        )
    }
    candidate
}

```

```{r}

# Absolute mzML path

provenance$file <- gsub(
    "Human_Endosome",
    "Human Endosome",
    provenance$file
)

provenance <- provenance |>
    dplyr::filter(lab != "icl")

provenance$mzml_path <-
    purrr::pmap_chr(
        list(
            provenance$lab,
            provenance$file,
            provenance$polarity
        ),
        find_mzml_file,
        mzml_dirs = mzml_dirs
    )

head(provenance$mzml_path)

```

###############################################################
# 10. Read mzML
###############################################################

```{r}

read_mzml <- function(file){
    Spectra(
        file,
        backend = MsBackendMzR()
    )
}

```

###############################################################
# 11. Extract required scans
###############################################################

```{r}

extract_required_spectra <-
function(sp, provenance_subset) {
    scan_numbers <- provenance_subset$acquisitionNum
    idx <- match(
        scan_numbers,
        acquisitionNum(sp)
    )
    if (anyNA(idx)) {
        missing_scans <- scan_numbers[is.na(idx)]
        mzml_file <- unique(provenance_subset$file)
        stop(
            "In file ", mzml_file,
            " the following acquisition numbers were not found: ",
            paste(missing_scans, collapse = ", ")
        )
    }
    sp <- sp[idx]
    sp
}

```

###############################################################
# 12. Read all mzML files
###############################################################

```{r}

spectra_list <- vector(
    "list",
    length(provenance_split)
)

names(spectra_list) <-
    names(provenance_split)

# Read spectra

for(i in seq_along(provenance_split)){
    message(
        "Reading ",
        basename(
            names(provenance_split)[i]
        )
    )
    prov <-
        provenance_split[[i]]
    sp <-
        read_mzml(
            unique(
                prov$mzml_path
            )
        )
    sp <-
        extract_required_spectra(
            sp,
            prov
        )
    spectra_list[[i]] <- sp
}

```

```{r}

# Check that all mzML files have been read

length(spectra_list)
sapply(
    spectra_list,
    length
)

```

###############################################################
# 13. Combine all spectra
###############################################################

```{r}

# As detailed in the documentation of the Spectra class, a Spectra object is a container for mass spectrometry (MS) data that includes both the mass peaks data (or peaks data, generally m/z and intensity values) as well as spectra metadata (so called spectra variables). Spectra variables generally define one value per spectrum, while for peaks variables one value per mass peak is defined and hence multiple values per spectrum (depending on the number of mass peaks of a spectrum).
# Data can be extracted from a Spectra object using dedicated accessor functions or also using the $ operator. Depending on the backend class used by the Spectra to represent the data, data can also be added or replaced (again, using dedicated functions or using ⁠$<-⁠).

ring_trial_spectra <- concatenateSpectra(spectra_list)

```

```{r}

# Checking

ring_trial_spectra

spectraVariables(ring_trial_spectra)
length(ring_trial_spectra)
peaksData(ring_trial_spectra)
mz(ring_trial_spectra)
intensity(ring_trial_spectra)

example <- ring_trial_spectra[1]
mz(example)[[1]]
intensity(example)[[1]]

methods("peaksData")
showMethods("peaksData")

```

```{r}

# Remove unnecessary values/objects previously created

rm(i, prov, sp, example)

```

###############################################################
# 14. Build the compound annotation table (one of the tables that `createCompDb()` expects)
###############################################################

```{r}

# Create the provenance annotations table, a copy of the provenance table with the correct order (provenance_split) and the corresponding compound_id (internal identifier for CompDb)

provenance_annotations <-
    dplyr::bind_rows(provenance_split) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        compound_id =
            match(
                inchikey,
                unique(inchikey)
            ),
        compound_id =
            as.character(compound_id)
    )

# Check that all spectra with exactly the same InChIKey are assigned the same compound_id

compound_id_check <-
    provenance_annotations |>
    distinct(
        inchikey,
        compound_id
    )

compound_id_check

compound_id_check <-
    provenance_annotations |>
    distinct(
        compound_id,
        inchikey
    ) |>
    count(compound_id) |>
    filter(n > 1)

stopifnot(nrow(compound_id_check) == 0)

# Check whether ‘provenance_annotations’ is correctly aligned with ‘ring_trial_spectra’

all(
    provenance_annotations$acquisitionNum ==
        acquisitionNum(ring_trial_spectra)
)

# Create the compound annotations table with the correct order (provenance_split) and the corresponding compound_id (internal identifier for CompDb), and with a single row per compound

compound_annotations <-
    provenance_annotations |>
    dplyr::select(
        compound_id,
        name,
        inchikey,
        inchikey_2d,
        sirius_structure,
        formula,
        ChEBI,
        KEGG,
        HMDB,
        LipidMaps,
        SMILES,
        inchi,
        exactmass,
        synonyms
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(compound_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

head(compound_annotations)

```

```{r}

# Remove unnecessary values/objects previously created

rm(compound_id_check)

```

###############################################################
# 16. Validate input tables (compound and MS/MS spectra tables)
###############################################################

```{r}

# Number of compounds

cat("Number of compound entries:",
    nrow(compound_annotations),
    "\n")

# Number of MS/MS spectra

cat("Number of MS/MS spectra:",
    nrow(msms_spectra),
    "\n")

# Mapping

stopifnot(
    nrow(msms_spectra) ==
        length(ring_trial_spectra)
)

# Peak consistency

stopifnot(
    length(msms_spectra$mz) ==
        length(msms_spectra$intensity)
)

stopifnot(
    all(
        lengths(msms_spectra$mz) ==
        lengths(msms_spectra$intensity)
    )
)

# Empty spectra (the output should be 0)

empty_spectra <-
    which(
        lengths(msms_spectra$mz) == 0
    )

length(empty_spectra)

# Missing precursor m/z

sum(
    is.na(
        msms_spectra$precursor_mz
    )
)

# Missing collision energy

sum(
    is.na(
        msms_spectra$collision_energy
    )
)

# Missing polarity

sum(
    is.na(
        msms_spectra$polarity
    )
)

# Aligned metadata (the output should be always TRUE)

all.equal(
    msms_spectra$precursor_mz,
    precursorMz(ring_trial_spectra)
)

all.equal(
    msms_spectra$collision_energy,
    collisionEnergy(ring_trial_spectra)
)

all.equal(
    msms_spectra$polarity,
    polarity(ring_trial_spectra)
)

```


###############################################################
# 17. Create metadata
###############################################################

```{r}

metadata <- make_metadata(
    source = "HUMAN Ring Trial - MetaSci Library (Human Metabolites)",
    source_version = "0.1.0",
    source_date = format(Sys.Date()),
    organism = "Hsapiens",
    url = "https://github.com/philouail/HUMAN_Ring_Trial"
)

metadata

```

###############################################################
# 18. Create CompDb output directory
###############################################################

```{r}

compdb_output_dir <-
    file.path(
        library_dir,
        "CompDb"
    )

if(!dir.exists(compdb_output_dir))
    dir.create(
        compdb_output_dir,
        recursive = TRUE
    )

compdb_file <-
    file.path(
        compdb_output_dir,
        "RingTrial.sqlite"
    )

if(file.exists(compdb_file))
    file.remove(compdb_file)

```

###############################################################
# 19. Create the CompDb database
###############################################################

```{r}

compdb_file <-
    createCompDb(
        x = compound_annotations,
        msms_spectra = msms_spectra,
        metadata = metadata,
        path = compdb_output_dir,
        dbFile = "RingTrial.sqlite"
    )

cat("Database written to:\n")
cat(compdb_file, "\n")

```

###############################################################
# 20. Load the CompDb database
###############################################################

```{r}

ring_trial_db <- CompDb(compdb_file)

ring_trial_db

```

###############################################################
# 21. Validate the CompDb
###############################################################

```{r}

# Metadata

metadata(ring_trial_db)

# Available variables

compoundVariables(ring_trial_db)

# Available database tables

CompoundDb::tables(ring_trial_db)

# SQLite connection

SQLite_connection <- CompoundDb::dbconn(ring_trial_db)

# SQLite tables

DBI::dbListTables(SQLite_connection)

DBI::dbGetQuery(
    SQLite_connection,
    "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table';"
)

DBI::dbGetQuery(
    SQLite_connection,
    "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT compound_id) AS n_compounds
     FROM ms_compound"
)

# Compounds

compounds(
    ring_trial_db,
    columns = c(
        "compound_id",
        "name",
        "inchikey",
        "formula",
        "exactmass"
    )
)

# Number of compounds

nrow(
    compounds(
        ring_trial_db,
        columns = "compound_id"
    )
)

# Number of spectra

compounds(ring_trial_db) |>
    nrow()

nrow(compound_annotations)

# Does the database contain MS/MS spectra?

hasMsMsSpectra(ring_trial_db) # should be TRUE

# Load the spectra

library(Spectra)

ring_trial_library <-
    Spectra(ring_trial_db)

ring_trial_library

spectraVariables(ring_trial_library) # available spectrum variables (to check what information has been stored in the CompDb)

AnnotationFilter::supportedFilters(ring_trial_db)

head(
    spectraData(ring_trial_library)
)

CompoundDb::tables(ring_trial_db)$msms_spectrum

CompoundDb::tables(ring_trial_db)$ms_compound

Spectra::coreSpectraVariables()

getMethod(
    "backendInitialize",
    "MsBackendCompDb"
)

# Numbers of spectra (should be the same)

length(ring_trial_library)

length(ring_trial_spectra)

```

###############################################################
# 22. Validate spectral integrity
###############################################################

```{r}

original <- ring_trial_spectra[1]
retrieved <- ring_trial_library[1]

# Compare masses

identical(
    mz(original)[[1]],
    mz(retrieved)[[1]]
)

# Compare intensities

identical(
    intensity(original)[[1]],
    intensity(retrieved)[[1]]

)

# Compare precursor

precursorMz(original)
precursorMz(retrieved)

# Compare collision energy

collisionEnergy(original)
collisionEnergy(retrieved)

```

```{r}

# Remove unnecessary values/objects previously created

rm(original, retrieved)

```

###############################################################

```{r}
# Search for a compound

Spectra(
    ring_trial_db,
    filter =
        ~ name == "5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan"
)
```

###############################################################
# 24. Plot an MS/MS spectrum
###############################################################

```{r}

example <-
    Spectra(
        ring_trial_db,
        filter =
            ~ name == "5-hydroxy-L-tryptophan"
    )[1]

plotSpectra(
    example
)

```

###############################################################
# 25. Pairwise comparison
###############################################################

```{r}

# As the entire library is stored as a Spectra object, we can use the functions from the Spectra package directly

comparison <-
    compareSpectra(
        example,
        ring_trial_library,
        ppm = 20
    )

comparison

```

```{r}

# Remove unnecessary values/objects previously created

rm(example, comparison)

```

###############################################################
# 26. Future developments
###############################################################

The workflow presented here establishes the basic infrastructure for the HUMAN
Ring Trial spectral library.

Future versions of the library may include:

- additional participating laboratories (e.g. ICL);
- all Ring Trial mixtures beyond the Human Endosome subset;
- additional compound annotations (SMILES, PubChem CID, HMDB, ChEBI);
- instrument metadata;
- chromatographic conditions;
- retention indices;
- spectral quality metrics;
- automatic export to MSP;
- automatic export to MassBank;
- automatic export to GNPS;
- periodic versioning of the library.
